IMC.content:
From quant research and trading, to engineering and business operations, we provide dynamic opportunities for ambitious, hard-working people from all backgrounds and experience levels.
Explore our specialised, global roles for experienced professionals:
Quant Research
Join IMC’s growing global quant research team as we build for our future with new strategies and technologies.
Challenge yourself at the cutting edge of financial technology with roles across software, hardware, and beyond.
Students & Future Graduates
Curious about a career in trading and tech? Check out our diverse range of insight programmes that we run all around the world.
Internships
Put your skills to the test during an IMC internship, where you'll work on real business projects, guided by experienced IMC professionals.
Graduates
All graduate hires join IMC’s Graduate Traineeship. With dedicated schools for analysts, engineers, traders, and quants, our Graduate Traineeship is designed to challenge our new hires and set you up for success.
Explore our global offices to see where you could make your mark as part of the IMC team.
IMC encourages continuous learning for employees at all levels. We offer several internal and external training programmes to encourage personal and skill development. Graduates begin their IMC career with an extensive Graduate Traineeship at one of our global office locations.

XTX Markets.content:
Quant Research
The quantitative research team is responsible for designing the statistical models that underpin our trading activities.
In the fast-moving environment of financial markets, we face numerous technical challenges. However, as a cohesive team of quantitative researchers, we are constantly developing new models to stay ahead.
My favourite aspect of the job is working in a collaborative, research-driven environment with a fast feedback loop that allows for rapid progress and keeps the whole process engaging and impactful.
, Quant Research
Our team is drawn from a range of financial and non-financial backgrounds. We specialise in building high-performance, highly-available distributed systems. We are given a high degree of autonomy to meet requirements with the software and hardware that we see fit.
What I value most about working at XTX is the firm's commitment to quality software engineering. We look to build solutions that stand the test of time and scale with the needs of the business.
I also really enjoy working closely with the trading analyst and quant teams to help solve any client queries.
---LINKS---

GSA Capital.content:
Join GSA and become part of a leading quant trading firm where innovation and performance drive us forward. We're looking for individuals with the expertise and determination to contribute to our continued success.
Regardless of your level of experience, if you’re talented in the areas of Compliance/Legal, Finance, HR, Office Management, Operations, Procurement, Recruitment or Trading Operations and wish to explore possibilities at GSA then we’re always open to making connections.
IT Engineer
Working to a precision demanded by only a few companies and government agencies around the world, designing and running an ultra high performance global infrastructure requires a different breed of system and network engineer.
Quantitative Researcher
If you have outstanding academic credentials and believe you possess relevant attributes to successfully contribute towards the research, implementation and continued development of new and existing strategies, please get in touch.
Quantitative Researcher
If you have outstanding academic credentials and believe you possess relevant attributes to successfully contribute towards the research, implementation and continued development of new and existing strategies, please get in touch.
Quantitative Researcher - Intern
As a minimum, you must have an outstanding academic track record in a STEM, economics or empirical finance discipline from a leading academic institution and be able to demonstrate a passion and understanding for working within a quantitative environment.
For candidates requiring visa sponsorship or additional immigration/right-to-work processing assistance, we encourage you to apply by end of March to allow sufficient time to complete the visa application and/or complete necessary checks before the internship start date.
Software Developer
Software development forms a vital component of many aspects of the business at GSA Capital. Ability combined with passion for technology has allowed our teams to build systems that would never be available off the shelf.
As a software developer, you don’t need to have a background in finance but you do need to be able to demonstrate that you are passionate about using your skills to solve relevant problems.
Software Developer - Intern
We are interested in hearing from students in the penultimate year of their graduate or postgraduate studies who are looking to secure an internship within software development.
For candidates requiring visa sponsorship or additional immigration/right-to-work processing assistance, we encourage you to apply by end of March to allow sufficient time to complete the visa application and/or complete necessary checks before the internship start date.
